In [[19 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] flew a '''Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor''' with a paint job similar to that of the [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7B starfighter]] that he flew in the earlier stages of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Blade of Dorin]]. Koon's [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7]] was destroyed when Koon was [[Death|killed]] by his [[Clone trooper pilot|clone wingmen]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge|execution]] of [[Order 66]], as was its integrated [[astromech droid]], [[R4-F5]].

==Description==
[[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]] gave his [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7]] a [[color]] scheme similar to the [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7B starfighter]]<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> that he used prior to the Delta-7, painting it blue with convergent white stripes. The [[astromech droid]] [[R4-F5]] was integrated into the [[starfighter]] as Koon's [[navigator]] and [[Pilot|copilot]].<ref name="Build R2 48" />

==History==
[[File:JediCommander-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Plo Koon patrols escorted by three V-wings.]]
In the early stages of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi]] Master [[Jedi General|General]] Plo Koon, along with the astromech droid [[R7-D4]], flew a Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence" /> given to him by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode Guide: Holocron Heist">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> At some point Koon instead began using a Delta-7 coupled with R4-F5.<ref name="Build R2 48" />

Koon flew his Delta-7 during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]]<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Date note" /> shortly before the end of the Clone Wars. The [[starfighter]], including its integrated astromech, was destroyed by Koon's [[Clone trooper pilot|clone wingmen]] when they received [[Order 66]] from the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], [[Death|killing]] Plo Koon as well.<ref name="ROTS" />
